fallback.title: Open inside Telegram
fallback.body: This page runs as a Telegram Mini App: you sign in with your Telegram account and link a phone with one tap.

boot.failed: Could not sign in through Telegram. Close and reopen the app.

common.loadFailed: Could not load. Reopen the app.

home.bookableEmpty: No open spots today. Next days are on the terminal page.
home.urgentHint: Locomotive, repair or crane: offers within an hour

phone.title: Confirm your phone
phone.body: Orders and urgent requests need a phone. Share your contact and the number is linked automatically.
phone.waiting: The bot is receiving your contact
phone.timeout: The number has not arrived yet. Check that the contact was sent to the bot and try again.
phone.declined: Contact not shared. Without a phone you can only browse.
phone.unsupported: Your Telegram is outdated. Open the bot and send the contact there.

search.title: Search
search.empty: Nothing found. Try another word or region.

terminal.noTariffs: No tariff published, price on request.

book.noOffer: This terminal has no tariff for this operation. Choose another operation or terminal.

err.HOLD_ALREADY_USED: An order already exists for this spot.

err.NOT_SHIPPER: You cannot order on behalf of this organization.
err.NO_TARIFF_FOR_OPERATION: The terminal has no tariff for this operation.
err.OPERATION_NOT_OFFERED: The terminal does not perform this operation.

detail.noDocs: No documents yet: the act and invoice appear after the order is completed.

detail.cancelNote: Cancellation is unavailable less than 12 hours before the spot starts.

hint.PENDING: Waiting for the terminal to confirm. Otherwise the spot is released automatically.
hint.CONFIRMED: The spot is reserved for you. Arrive at the scheduled time.
hint.IN_PROGRESS: Work is in progress at the terminal.
hint.REJECTED: The terminal declined. Choose another terminal or time.
hint.EXPIRED: The terminal did not respond in time, the spot was released.

err.CANCEL_TOO_LATE: Less than 12 hours before the spot, cancellation is unavailable. Contact the terminal.

listing.loginNote: The price is public; phone and inquiry go through your Telegram account.
